number-theory.label: Problem Set 1
number-theory.title: Euclid and the architecture of the integers
number-theory.description: Divisibility, greatest common divisors, Bézout identities, prime factorization, and the infinitude of primes.

number-theory.label: Week 2
number-theory.title: Division, primes, and finite continued fractions
number-theory.description: Turn Euclidean calculations, a sieve, and finite continued fractions into proofs. Test divisibility claims with counterexamples.

number-theory.label: Weekly quiz collection
number-theory.title: Ten checkpoints from Euclid to primes
number-theory.description: Short, self-contained quizzes following the course sequence, with space to write calculations and proofs.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 1
probability-statistics.title: The geometry of events
probability-statistics.description: Set notation, complements, De Morgan’s laws, Venn diagrams, and inclusion–exclusion. No probability background assumed.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 2
probability-statistics.title: Counting, events, and shared birthdays
probability-statistics.description: Probability spaces, permutations, combinations, binomial identities, inclusion–exclusion, and the birthday paradox.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 3
probability-statistics.title: Counting, collisions, and derangements
probability-statistics.description: Discrete probability spaces, poker and word counts, birthday bounds, collision patterns, and the hat-check problem.

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Conditional probability and Bayes’ rule
probability-statistics.description: Finite probability spaces, conditioning from a table, total probability, and a guided solution to Monty Hall.

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Birthdays, derangements, and a little calculus
probability-statistics.description: The series and approximations behind birthday collisions and derangements, followed by a Bayes’ rule problem.

probability-statistics.label: Weekly quiz collection
probability-statistics.title: Ten checkpoints from sets to inference
probability-statistics.description: Short quizzes following the course from events and distributions through estimation and Bayesian inference, with writing space.
